lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the branchial region, with a primary group of three centroids forming an obtuse triangular arrangement in the mid-lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the high-luminance circular blobs to form a grid-like structural pattern across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features run across the superior third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity on the upper edge and shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs that are significantly smaller and more concentrated than the blobs found on the lateral flank.
